messages:
olivia: Heads-up — oat milk is down to one carton in the fridge and someone left a mason jar labeled 'STAFF COFFEE' with mystery granules. Please don't brew it unless you know the ritual :grimacing:

sam: Yikes. I opened that jar last week thinking it was instant and nearly murdered the french press. I'll swing by the co-op at 12:20 if no one else can. Need anything else?

olivia: Legend. Can you grab 2x Oatly Barista and a small almond creamer? Also a sleeve of biscotti if easy. I'll Venmo.

tara: If you're going to the co-op can you grab our official sugar stash? I think the jar is near-empty. 1kg cane sugar is fine.

matt: Also, the grinder's been squealing — probably just beans. If we keep using the disposable coffee jar I will stage an intervention. :coffee:

sam: On it. Shopping list: `Oatly Barista x2, Almond creamer, 1kg cane sugar, Biscotti or cookies`. ETA ~12:40 back at HQ. Want cold brew concentrate too?

olivia: Cold brew would be amazing but only if it won't melt your soul to carry. If not, skip. Thanks!! :heart:

sophie: Quick poll — are we okay with me ordering lunch for the team while you're out? I can do sandwiches from Corner Deli. Vote: sandwich, salad, skip

matt: sandwich

tara: salad (but I can eat a sandwich if that's easier)

olivia: sandwich — group morale depends on biscotti + sandwich synergy.

kitchen-bot: Inventory snapshot at 11:34 — OAT_MILK=1 carton, ALMOND_CREAMER=0, SUGAR_G=120, COFFEE_BEANS=310g, INSTANT_JAR=1 (unknown).

sam: okay will pick up almond creamer too and I'll quarantine the mason jar in the top cupboard with a sticky note: `DO NOT TOUCH — experiment (ask olivia)`

olivia: Thanks for rescuing the kitchen economy. I'll bring the funny 'experiment' label and a small note explaining contents. :laughing:

matt: If anyone's passing a hardware store later, can someone peek at the grinder? Might be a loose burr. Otherwise I'll schedule a quick maintenance hour Thursday.

tara: I'll ping facilities to see if they have a spare burr or can book a tech.

sam: Back slightly late but bought everything. Put items in fridge and left the receipt on the counter. `Total: $23.65 — sam (venmo @sam)`

olivia: Legend. Re: receipt — can we start a shared kitchen tab spreadsheet? Or just Venmo for now.

sophie: I got sandwiches ordered and will pick up at 12:50. Team lunch in the kitchenette at 1pm?

matt: 1pm works. I'll bring my noise-cancelling headphones so I don't judge the biscotti crunch too loudly.

olivia: Thanks everyone. Kitchen saved. Also I put the mason jar in the top cupboard labeled with my note — it's probably some kind of instant chicory experiment that eluded inspection. :microscope:
